India's Cheapest Electric Car Launched at ₹4.24 Lakh

The Indian electric car market has gained a new entrant with the launch of an EV priced at ₹4.24 lakh, capable of covering 1200km on a full charge. The car features a 7-inch touchscreen display. The government has announced plans to promote electric vehicles in the country.
